name: M7.GlobalQuery.winning_classes
statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (i : Fin H), i ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winningClasses q bases ↔ ∃ g : M7.Action.Record N, (i,g) ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases
guidance: Unfold winningClasses and use Finset.mem_image; product extensionality converts the first component equality. Keep every tied class. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.
